projects.title: Aluminum Head — Faceted Metal Sculpture
projects.subtitle: Form-finding, sheet fabrication and assembly
projects.summary: The faceted aluminum head photographed in the workshop, with related triangular panel prototypes and folded-metal assemblies. This project shows geometric decomposition translated into a physical sculptural form.
projects.competitionFit: Direct evidence of fabricated metal sculpture and complex assembly — particularly relevant for the Norfolk and Hoboken public-art submissions.
projects.review: The sculptural head and related triangular fabrications are grouped visually; verify the precise role, credits and whether all shop prototypes belong to the same commission.

projects.title: Thermoformed Corian Fin Wall
projects.subtitle: Curved fins, forming jigs and completed interior
projects.summary: A study of flowing fin geometry in Corian solid surface, from shop-cut components and forming fixtures to wavelike installed fins. Fabrication and installation details are kept together to show how a computational surface becomes buildable.
projects.competitionFit: Strong evidence of material experimentation, full-scale fabrication, detailing and installation planning.
projects.review: Corian thermoforming and MAK Studio are confirmed by the portfolio owner. Check whether all dark-fin close-ups are the same commission and add client/collaborator credits.
projects.portfolioCredit: Alireza Memarian · Work at MAK Studio

projects.title: Austin Tessellated Installation
projects.subtitle: Triangulated structural and faceted wall geometry
projects.summary: Tessellated geometry developed through triangulated shop mockups, nested fabrication parts, timber framing, and finished faceted architectural surfaces. The project series is identified as Austin work by the portfolio owner.
projects.competitionFit: Shows project-specific geometry, construction sequencing, and coordination between a digital tessellation and a built architectural feature.
projects.review: The triangular shop work and installed cladding have been grouped visually; confirm which individual images share the same Austin project.

projects.title: Interactive Outdoor Public Art
projects.subtitle: Built freestanding patterned installation
projects.summary: Photographs of a freestanding outdoor patterned artwork at installation, after completion, and at night. The steel or aluminum detailing and exact venue are not established by the filenames.
projects.competitionFit: An especially relevant built-work precedent for interactive public-space sculpture, installation logistics and durable outdoor detailing.
projects.review: Confirm title, exact metal/material, site, role, and participating artists before presenting this as a named commission.

projects.title: Perforated Metal Portrait Artwork
projects.subtitle: Image as perforation, fabrication and exhibition
projects.summary: Close views and exhibition photographs of a perforated portrait panel, using controlled open area and light to reproduce an image in a physical surface.
projects.competitionFit: Relevant precedent for the Waterside fish-panel proposal: variation, perforation, material and visual communication through fabricated metal.
projects.review: The face is part of the artwork, not a personal portrait photograph. Confirm the panel material, title, collaborators and exact role.

projects.title: CNC-Patterned Feature Wall
projects.subtitle: Design diagrams, carved panel texture and built interiors
projects.summary: A coordinated series of MAK Studio design diagrams and installed carved-pattern wall photographs, showing milled texture, curved cutouts, modular surface construction and spatial detail.
projects.competitionFit: Well suited to public-art applications where workmanship, constructability and integration with an architectural setting matter.
projects.review: Project and studio grouping is supported by the filenames, but individual contribution and collaboration credits require review.
projects.portfolioCredit: Alireza Memarian · Work at MAK Studio

projects.title: Parametric Screens, Metal Mesh & Light
projects.subtitle: Pattern generation, spatial depth and illumination
projects.summary: Perforated surface studies, cellular patterns, and illuminated installations exploring how repeatable components generate curved, porous and luminous forms.
projects.competitionFit: Connects algorithmic design with light, shadow and layered public-art surfaces.
projects.review: Several images are digital design studies rather than verified completed aluminum installations; materials must be confirmed.

projects.title: Modular Cellular Planter Sculpture
projects.subtitle: Fabricated cells and planted spatial prototype
projects.summary: Physical cellular modules, geometric nesting and vegetation studies forming a sculptural planting system.
projects.competitionFit: Relevant to resilience-park objectives and the integration of plants with public art.
projects.review: Verify title, exact material, and whether this series is one project.

projects.title: Inventure Workplace Interiors
projects.subtitle: Custom workplace elements and interiors
projects.summary: Documentation of built interior spaces, sculpted work areas, furniture and architectural finishes.
projects.competitionFit: Evidence of delivered human-scale environments, detailed construction and interior integration.

projects.title: Timber Ceiling & Interior Installation
projects.subtitle: Custom curved ceiling and fit-out
projects.summary: An architectural interior defined by a rhythmic timber ceiling. Rendered views and installation photographs show the treatment from design intent to completed space.
projects.review: Exact project title and role are not provided in filenames; confirm before naming a client.
